name: Special South Gate City Council
minutes_text:
CITY OF SOUTH GATE
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY, MAY 27, 2025

CALL TO ORDER  Maria Davila, Mayor called a Special City Council Meeting to order at
  5:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL  Yodit Glaze, City Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor Maria Davila, Vice Mayor Joshua Barron, Council Member Maria
  del Pilar Avalos, Council Member Gil Hurtado and Council Member Al
  Rios; City Treasurer Jose De La Paz, City Manager Rob Houston, City
  Attorney Raúl F. Salinas

1
CERTIFICATES OF
APPRECIATION  On behalf of the City Council, Mayor Maria Davila:

  a. Presented Certificates of Appreciation to the outgoing 2024 Miss
  South Gate Court for serving on the court and for their dedication in
  representing the City; and

  b. Introduced the incoming 2025 Miss South Gate Court.

2
CERTIFICATES OF
APPRECIATION  The City Council issued Certificates of Appreciation to the STEAM
  students participating in the Robotics World Championship.

3
CERTIFICATES OF
APPRECIATION  The City Council issued Certificates of Appreciation to the South Gate
  High School Cheer Team Members Recognized for Their 2025
  Championship Win.

4
PERSONNEL RECRUITMENT
& SELECTION  The City Council considered receiving and filing the list of new and
  promoted full-time employees hired or promoted during April 2024.

CLOSED SESSION  The Council Members recessed into Closed Session at 5:46 p.m. and
  reconvened at 6:36 p.m., in order that the Council might hold its Regular
  City Council Meeting. The meeting reconvened at 12:01 a.m. with all
  Council present.
   SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING  MINUTES  OF MAY  27, 2025

CLOSED  SESSION  The Council  Members  recessed  into Closed  Session  at 12:01  a.m.
  and reconvened  at 12:09  a.m. withAll  Members  of Council  present
  City Attorney  Salinas  reported  the following:

  CONFERENCE  WITH  LEGAI,  COUNSEL  - PENDING
  LITIGATION
  Pursuant  to Governrnent  Code Section  54956.9(a),
  54954.9(b)(3)(C)

  a.  Meredith  Elguira  v. City  of South  Gate, et al.

  Item 1(a) was discussed  in Closed  Session,  but no reportable  action  was
  taken.  This item  WEIS  aided by outside  counsel.

  CONFERENCE  WITH  LAJ30R  NEGOTIATOR
  Pursuant  to Government  Code Section  54957.6

  Agency  Representation:  Rob Houston,  City  Manager

  Unrepresented  Employees:  Top Management/Department
  Directors/Hourly  Employees

  Employee  Organizations:  SGMEA,  SGPMMA,  SGDMA,
  SGPMA,  SGPOA

  Item 2 was not discussed  in detail  and was rescheduled  for a Special  City
  Council  Meeting  for June 3, 2025,  at 6:30 p.m.

ADJOURNMENT  Council  MemberAvalos  unanimously  adjourned  the meeting  at 12:11  a.m.
  and seconded  by Council  Member  Rios.

PASSED  and APPROVED  on this 24"  day of June 2025.

  ATTEST:

47
Maria  Davila,
